FEAT-3-S110.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Query Construction and Recruiting Filter Enforcement
FEAT-3-S110.description: Implement and validate query construction logic to ensure all searches enforce RECRUITING status and correctly map user inputs (condition, geography) into ClinicalTrials.gov API parameters.

FEAT-3-S111.title: Travel Distance and Duration Computation via Google Routes
FEAT-3-S111.description: Implement travel distance and duration calculation between user location and trial sites using Google Routes API, including batching and fallback handling for missing coordinates.

FEAT-3-S112.title: Clinical Trials Result Formatting and Location Extraction
FEAT-3-S112.description: Parse ClinicalTrials.gov API responses to extract trial metadata, normalize site locations, and format results with distance and duration for downstream consumption.
